author: CNET
description:
At Google I/O in June, 2012, co-founder Sergey Brin showcased Project Glass by streaming live Hangout footage of skydivers jumping from a plane while wearing the smart spectacles.

Read more about it on CNET.com
Everything We Know About Google’s Upcoming Smart Glasses Ahead of I/O https://zdcs.link/zj3GDy
 
0:00  Sergey Brin interrupts the presentation for a special demo
0:46  Sergey connects with skydivers via a Google Glass Hangout
1:58  The view from a mile above the Moscone Center
2:49  The airplane doors open
3:15  Skydivers exit the plane and fly over San Francisco
4:02  Parachutes deploy
5:07  Skydivers land on the roof of the Moscone Center
6:01  Bikers receive the Google Glass unit on the roof
6:21  Rappelling down the side of the building
7:05  The final bike ride through the conference hall
7:37  The Google Glass unit successfully arrives on stage
